why: The last release the Credible fleet ran without heartbeat failures (ms2data/service#7795). Nightly and release runs compare against this fixed point, not the release before, so a regression that arrives in steps under 1.5x each still adds up to a failure. Move it forward only after a release has run in the fleet without main-thread trouble, in a PR of its own.

calibrated.note: The anchor as a baseline in this storm (the #7641 calibration rounds); a run whose anchor median is beyond twice the top is invalid.
